name: Mediarium Requests
description: Find and request movies and shows from Mediarium inside Jellyfin: a Request page in Jellyfin Web, a Discover library where favouriting a title requests it, and a pop-up when what you asked for is ready.
overview: Request movies and shows from Mediarium without leaving Jellyfin

versions.changelog: Choose seasons when asking for a show: the title panel lists the seasons and where each stands, and a show already in the library can be asked for the seasons it doesn't have. Needs a Mediarium with season requests.
Request from Jellyfin's own search: a "Not in your library" row in Jellyfin Web's search, and Request instead of Play on Discover titles.
First release: Request page, Discover library, ready pop-up and "Ready for you" playlist.
